# Vetoschool

> Vetoschool is an online English school for children ages 5–12, with live lessons, interactive workbooks, homework, practice and progress tracking.

Lessons are taught online by qualified teachers in small groups or one-to-one. Students learn through interactive tasks (matching, word building, letter filling, anagrams), a dictionary trainer, homework with grades, and a stars reward system. Parents can receive progress notifications via Telegram.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Vetoschool is, how lessons work, and how to start.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Group and individual English learning plans with full platform access.
- [Book a free trial lesson](/trial-booking): Reserve a free trial lesson and get a preliminary English level recommendation for your child.
